english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when something changes or increases by a considerable amount.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something increases, improves, decreases, or changes considerably.
Pick this for a stronger, more emphatic sense of “greatly,” especially before verbs such as 改善 or 提高.

examples.english: Business at this restaurant improved significantly after the renovation.
examples.traditional: 呢間餐廳裝修之後，生意大大好轉。

examples.english: This new measure has substantially improved citizens’ quality of life.
examples.traditional: 呢個新措施令市民嘅生活質素大大提高咗。

examples.english: This new arrangement has considerably improved work efficiency.
examples.traditional: 呢個新安排大大改善咗工作效率。
